hook.name: PlumbHook
hook.description: A bonding curve hook that intercepts all swaps to execute buy/sell operations on its own ERC-20 token (PlumbToken) via a custom price curve with a ratcheting ETH floor price backstop. External liquidity additions are disabled. Includes a team-controlled graduation mechanism that migrates accumulated ETH liquidity to a full-range Uniswap v3 position.
